name: Ranseur
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 19, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 19, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
Statistics
Cost 10 gp Weight 12 lbs.
Damage 1d6 (small), 2d4 (medium); Critical x3; Range —; Type P; Special disarm, reach
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Polearms
Description
Similar in appearance to a trident, a ranseur has a single spear at its tip, flanked by a pair of short, curving blades.
